turns.text: They were just communicating naturally and effectively.
turns.zh: 他们就是在自然又有效地交流。

turns.text: That's what real English sounds like.
turns.zh: 真正的英语就是这个样子。

turns.text: So, our challenge for you this week is simple.
turns.zh: 所以，我们这周给大家的挑战很简单。

turns.text: Have at least one meaningful conversation in English.
turns.zh: 至少用英语进行一次有意义的对话。

turns.text: Ask follow-up questions, share a personal story, and try to use some of those natural expressions we discussed today.
turns.zh: 多问追问性的问题，分享一个自己的故事，试着用上我们今天聊到的一些自然表达。

turns.text: We'd love to hear about your experiences.
turns.zh: 我们很想听听大家的经历。
